content.comment_body: Hello! I have a [article_no] device with a KNX module. I'm unable to monitor the digital input status of the [product_name]. I can view the digital output status and send analog values to the [product_name], but not the DI status. Any assistance on how to resolve this would be appreciated. Perhaps there is a newer application program with some fixes. Currently, I'm working with ETS3.0f and the [product_name] V3 application program. Previously, I experienced a similar issue with Synco 700, which was resolved by updating to ETS4. Could this be a comparable case? Thank you in advance! Best regards, [user_name].

I've encountered some peculiar behavior. I found the manual for the EIB module [article_no]. The configuration example indicates that I should connect input I1 to an available output Q5, for instance. Conversely, to control a Qxx, I should connect it to a free input I13-24. This setup works for my scenario—I can see the signal from I1 according to the manual. However, I can also see Q1's status without connecting it to a free digital input. Ultimately, my main question is: what is the purpose of assigning digital inputs (I1-I9) in the ETS application if they appear unusable? Thanks for your help. Best regards, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing difficulty monitoring digital input statuses using a [product_name] [article_no] device with a KNX communications module in ETS3.0f and [product_name] V3 application program. While digital outputs and analog value transmission function correctly, digital inputs are either not visible or do not operate as expected in the ETS environment. The user references documentation and configuration workarounds, noting inconsistency in the way DIs and DOs are handled and expressing confusion about the inclusion of DIs in the application program.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to directly monitor digital inputs of the [product_name] within the ETS application program, just like digital outputs. They seek functional utility for DIs in ETS and are hoping for updated software or solutions to enable this capability.
